terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, in his computer vocabulary.

terms.gloss: a table of accounts: a spreadsheet
terms.comment: Our use, beside Traupman’s phrase, of a classical word that says what a spreadsheet is: Lewis & Short: a statistical table, a book of accounts; Suetonius’s word for the survey of the empire’s resources that Augustus drew up. A spreadsheet is such a table on a computer.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 262, 384.
